violations.name: No Reject Button on First Layer
violations.description: Cookie banner lacks equally prominent reject button alongside accept button
violations.detection_method: DOM analysis for buttons with data-action='reject' or similar, compare styling with accept button
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 7(4) - Consent must be freely given
violations.edpb_guidance: Consent must be as easy to withdraw as to give

precedents.summary: No easy way to refuse cookies

violations.name: Pre-ticked Boxes
violations.description: Checkboxes for non-essential cookies are pre-selected by default
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 4(11) - Consent requires affirmative action
violations.edpb_guidance: Pre-ticked boxes do not constitute valid consent

violations.name: Deceptive Link Design
violations.description: Settings/Reject option displayed as small text link while Accept is prominent button
violations.detection_method: Compare font-size, color, element type of settings link vs accept button
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 7(4) - No undue influence on consent
violations.edpb_guidance: All options must be presented with equal prominence

violations.name: Deceptive Button Colours
violations.description: Accept button uses attractive color (green/blue) while Reject is grey/muted
violations.detection_method: Analyze background-color CSS of accept vs reject buttons
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 7(4) - Consent must be freely given
violations.edpb_guidance: Visual design must not nudge users toward acceptance

violations.name: Deceptive Button Contrast
violations.description: Accept button is larger, bolder, or more prominent than Reject
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 7(4) - Consent must be freely given

violations.name: Legitimate Interest Claimed for Ads
violations.description: Banner claims 'legitimate interest' as legal basis for advertising/profiling
violations.detection_method: Text search for 'legitimate interest' in banner, check if linked to ad categories
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) - Legitimate interest does not apply to intrusive ads
violations.edpb_guidance: Legitimate interest cannot override need for consent in most advertising cases

precedents.summary: Behavioral advertising requires consent, not legitimate interest

violations.name: Misclassified Essential Cookies
violations.description: Tracking/analytics cookies incorrectly labeled as 'necessary' or 'essential'
violations.detection_method: Check if cookies in 'necessary' category match known tracking patterns
violations.legal_basis: ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3) - Only strictly necessary cookies exempt
violations.edpb_guidance: Analytical cookies are not strictly necessary

violations.name: Difficult Consent Withdrawal
violations.description: No persistent mechanism to withdraw consent after it's given
violations.detection_method: Look for hovering icon, footer link, or settings button on subsequent pages
violations.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 7(3) - Withdrawal must be as easy as giving consent
violations.edpb_guidance: Users must have ongoing ability to change preferences

precedents.summary: No option to withdraw consent after initial acceptance
